props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the pointer

props.name: interaction
props.description: Zoom (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, pinch), pan (drag), double-click reset and keyboard navigation; `false` makes the chart static (default `true`)

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the user drag the dots (default: when a `pointDrop` listener is set)

props.name: showCounts
props.type: boolean | ((count: number, points: readonly QuadrantPoint[]) => string)
props.description: Shows the number of points of each quadrant after its title; a function returns the text
props.typeText: boolean | ((count: number, points: readonly QuadrantPoint[]) => string)

props.name: showTicks
props.description: Shows the numeric ticks of the axes (default `true`)

props.name: reverseX
props.description: Reverses the horizontal axis (e.g. "urgent" on the left)

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Draws the labels next to the dots (default `true`)

props.name: selectedIndex
props.description: Index of the selected point, drawn with a ring (`null`: none)

props.name: accessiblePoints
props.description:
Renders a visually hidden list of the points per quadrant: screen
readers can reach every point; arrows move between them, Enter clicks
and Shift + arrows move the focused point to the neighbouring quadrant
(`pointDrop`, with a `pointDrop` listener)

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the data layer: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D (default `auto`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: annotations
props.description: Background areas and reference lines

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip, axes, accessible names); the page language by default

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the points in the tooltip

props.name: points
props.description: Points to place (replace the array to update the chart)

props.description: Range of the horizontal axis (default `[0, 10]`)

props.name: yDomain
props.description: Range of the vertical axis (default `[0, 10]`)

props.name: xSplit
props.description: X value of the vertical divider (the middle of `xDomain` by default)

props.name: ySplit
props.description: Y value of the horizontal divider (the middle of `yDomain` by default)

props.name: quadrants
props.description: Titles and colors of the quadrants

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Title of the horizontal axis

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Title of the vertical axis

props.name: axisLabels
props.description: Texts at the ends of the dividers, drawn inside the plot

props.name: pointSize

props.name: selectedIndices

events.name: quadrantClick
events.type: [quadrant: keyof QuadrantRegions, position: { x: number; y: number; }]
events.typeText: [quadrant: keyof QuadrantRegions, position: { x: number; y: number; }]

slots.name: point-actions
slots.description:
Actions of a point (e.g. compact edit / delete buttons), shown in the
point card of the hovered or focused point, else of the `selectedIndex`
point (with this slot, the selected point keeps its card); they receive
pointer events

slots.name: quadrant-header
slots.description:
Header of each quadrant, in its outer corner (top edge for the top
quadrants, bottom edge for the bottom ones, aligned to the outer side);
replaces the drawn title, badge, description and count. The header
receives pointer events (e.g. an add button)

<script setup lang="ts">
// Points, quadrant titles and axis titles; dots are placed without
// overlapping labels.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { QuadrantChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    effort: "Effort",
    impact: "Impact",
    quickWins: "Quick wins",
    bigBets: "Big bets",
    fillIns: "Fill-ins",
    timeSinks: "Time sinks",
    features: ["Dark mode", "SSO", "Search", "Export", "Onboarding", "Billing"],
  },
  zh: {
    effort: "投入",
    impact: "影响",
    quickWins: "速赢",
    bigBets: "重点投入",
    fillIns: "补充项",
    timeSinks: "低效项",
    features: ["深色模式", "单点登录", "搜索", "导出", "新手引导", "计费"],
  },
  ja: {
    effort: "工数",
    impact: "効果",
    quickWins: "クイックウィン",
    bigBets: "大型施策",
    fillIns: "穴埋め",
    timeSinks: "時間の浪費",
    features: [
      "ダークモード",
      "SSO",
      "検索",
      "エクスポート",
      "オンボーディング",
      "課金",
    ],
  },
  fr: {
    effort: "Effort",
    impact: "Impact",
    quickWins: "Gains rapides",
    bigBets: "Paris majeurs",
    fillIns: "Bouche-trous",
    timeSinks: "Pertes de temps",
    features: [
      "Mode sombre",
      "SSO",
      "Recherche",
      "Export",
      "Accueil",
      "Facturation",
    ],
  },
};

const SCORES: [number, number][] = [
  [2, 7.5],
  [7.5, 8.5],
  [6, 6.5],
  [3, 3],
  [4, 8],
  [8.5, 3.5],
];

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const points = computed(() =>
  SCORES.map(([x, y], i) => ({ x, y, label: text.value.features[i] })),
);
const quadrants = computed(() => ({
  topLeft: { label: text.value.quickWins },
  topRight: { label: text.value.bigBets },
  bottomLeft: { label: text.value.fillIns },
  bottomRight: { label: text.value.timeSinks },
}));
</script>

<template>
  <QuadrantChart
    :points="points"
    :quadrants="quadrants"
    :x-label="text.effort"
    :y-label="text.impact"
    :height="340"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Quadrant chart
translationResources.description: A four-quadrant matrix (priority, Eisenhower, BCG...) with tinted, titled quadrants and labelled dots.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Effort / impact matrix: dots take the color of their quadrant.

eisenhower.title: Eisenhower matrix
eisenhower.description: reverseX puts urgent tasks on the left; onPointClick receives the clicked task.

draggable.title: Draggable task matrix
draggable.description: showTicks={false} and axisLabels turn the chart into a task board: while dragging, the status line names the target quadrant (onPointDrag), and the drop updates the position (onPointDrop); double-click a task to rename it or move it to another quadrant (onPointDoubleClick); click an empty area or the + button (quadrantContent) to add one; renderTooltip fills the card of a task.

triage.title: Badges, counts and keyboard moves
triage.description: Quadrants show badges, descriptions and counts. Hovering or focusing a task shows a detached translucent card beside its point, with its name, quadrant and actions. The point keeps its real size and position; the card stays clear of it and changes sides when space is limited. The card replaces its label; the card goes when the pointer leaves, with Escape or with a click beside the tasks. A selected task keeps a ring. While a task is dragged the card follows it and names the quadrant it would land in. Tab enters the task list, Enter selects, and Shift + arrows move tasks between quadrants with live announcements.

quadrant-header.title: Custom quadrant headers
quadrant-header.description: renderQuadrantHeader replaces the drawn titles with React content in the outer corner of each quadrant: a badge, the title, an action hint, the count and total time from the info argument, and a + button that adds a task. getPointProps puts a data-testid on the invisible anchor of every dot for end-to-end tests.

bcg.title: BCG matrix
bcg.description: Product portfolio by relative market share and market growth: xDomain, yDomain, xSplit and ySplit place the dividing lines at a share of 1 and a growth of 10%, reverseX puts the leaders on the left and the dot size is the revenue.

risk.title: Risk matrix
risk.description: Project risks scored from 1 to 5 by likelihood and impact, with quadrant colors from accept (green) to act now (red); click a risk to select it, an empty area to clear.

positioning.title: Positioning map
positioning.description: Price against perceived quality from a customer survey: axisLabels replace the ticks and our brand stands out with its own color and size.

rice.title: RICE prioritization
rice.description: Backlog items by effort and by reach × impact, with the dot size following the RICE score; xDomain, yDomain, xSplit and ySplit set the scales and thresholds. The switch weights the value by confidence, which drops the speculative bets, and renderTooltip lists the four RICE inputs.

swot.title: SWOT analysis
swot.description: showTicks={false} and axisLabels turn the chart into a SWOT grid. quadrantContent adds a count badge in the inner corner of each quadrant, onQuadrantClick lists its factors and fades the others, and onPointClick names the clicked factor.

competitors.title: Competitor map
competitors.description: Pick the two dimensions to compare: the points, xLabel and yLabel follow the selects. Our product has its own color and size, and onPointClick shows a vendor's full profile against ours.

talent.title: Talent calibration
talent.description: Performance against potential during a calibration session. onPointDrag reads out the scores and the target quadrant while dragging, onPointDrop saves the move, and onPointDoubleClick puts a person back where they started; moved people get a bigger dot.

live-services.title: Live service health
live-services.description: Latency against error rate for each service, updated every second; the xSplit and ySplit lines are the SLO limits. The services in the critical quadrant are listed with quadrantOf, and renderTooltip formats the units with Intl.

QuadrantChartProps.onPointClick: Called with the clicked point and its index
QuadrantChartProps.onPointDoubleClick: Called with the point and its index when the same dot is clicked twice quickly
QuadrantChartProps.onPointDrag: Called with the point, its index and the quadrant under the pointer on every move of a dragged dot, before the drop (the dot does not move until onPointDrop)
QuadrantChartProps.onQuadrantClick: Called with the quadrant and the data position when the empty area of a quadrant is clicked
QuadrantChartProps.onPointDrop: Called with the point, its index and the drop target when a dragged dot is released; setting it makes the dots draggable (update points to move them)
QuadrantChartProps.renderPointActions: React actions (e.g. compact edit / delete icon buttons) shown in the card of the active point, beside its name: the hovered or focused point, else the selected one (with actions, the selected point keeps its card); receives the point and its index
QuadrantChartProps.renderTooltip: React content of the card of the active point, in place of its name and quadrant (the engine tooltip is not shown)
QuadrantChartProps.quadrantContent: React content placed over each quadrant (e.g. an add button); only that content receives pointer events
QuadrantChartProps.renderQuadrantHeader: React header of each quadrant in its outer corner (top edge for the top quadrants, bottom edge for the bottom ones); receives the corner and { count, points, indices, region } and replaces the drawn title, badge, description and count
QuadrantChartProps.accessiblePoints: Visually hidden list of buttons per quadrant for keyboard and screen reader users: arrow keys move between the points, Enter / Space calls onPointClick, Shift + arrow keys move the point to the next quadrant (onPointDrop, announced in a live region), and the focused dot gets a focus ring and is reported by onHover. Vue, Angular and Web Components (no-accessible-points) render the same layer; React Native exposes each point with ‘Move to …’ accessibility actions, and Taro, uni-app and WeChat a list of the points with ‘Move to …’ buttons
QuadrantChartProps.getPointProps: Extra attributes (e.g. data-testid) of the invisible anchor placed on each dot; every anchor has data-point-index, data-label and the class minerva-chart-quadrant-point

QuadrantConfig.xSplit: X value of the vertical divider (middle of xDomain by default)
QuadrantConfig.ySplit: Y value of the horizontal divider (middle of yDomain by default)
QuadrantConfig.quadrants: Titles and colors of the quadrants
QuadrantConfig.axisLabels: Texts at the ends of the dividers, drawn inside the plot (e.g. "Important" at the top)
QuadrantConfig.showTicks: Shows the numeric ticks of the axes; false keeps only the matrix
QuadrantConfig.reverseX: Reverses the horizontal axis (e.g. urgent on the left)
QuadrantConfig.showLabels: Draws the labels next to the dots, skipping overlaps
QuadrantConfig.name: Name of the points in the tooltip
QuadrantConfig.draggable: Lets the user drag the dots (on by default when onPointDrop or onPointDrag is set)
QuadrantConfig.showCounts: Shows the number of points of each quadrant after its title; a function (count, points) returns the text instead
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndex: Index of the selected point, drawn with a ring of its color (null: none)
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndices: Indices of the selected points, each drawn with a ring

QuadrantDropTarget.x: X data coordinate of the drop
QuadrantDropTarget.y: Y data coordinate of the drop
QuadrantDropTarget.quadrant: Quadrant of the drop, as seen on screen

QuadrantPoint.label: Text next to the dot and in the tooltip
QuadrantPoint.color: Dot color; the color of its quadrant by default

QuadrantRegion.label: Title drawn in the outer corner of the quadrant
QuadrantRegion.color: Background tint and default dot color
QuadrantRegion.badge: Short code drawn in a pill before the title (e.g. "Q1")
QuadrantRegion.description: Second line drawn under the title; cut with … when too long

QuadrantHeaderInfo.count: Number of points in the quadrant
QuadrantHeaderInfo.indices: Indices of these points in points
QuadrantHeaderInfo.region: Title, badge, description and color of the quadrant (quadrants)

QuadrantAxisLabels.top: Text at the top end of the vertical divider
QuadrantAxisLabels.bottom: Text at the bottom end of the vertical divider
QuadrantAxisLabels.left: Text at the left end of the horizontal divider
QuadrantAxisLabels.right: Text at the right end of the horizontal divider

basic.title: Basic

draggable.title: Drag between quadrants
draggable.description: Drag a task to another quadrant: onPointDrop receives the drop target; the + buttons are quadrantContent and the tooltip is a renderTooltip view.

triage.title: Badges, counts and selection
triage.description: Badges, a second line and the task count of each quadrant are drawn by the chart; tap a task to ring it (selectedIndex) or drag it to another quadrant.

priorities.title: Priority matrix
priorities.description: Features placed by effort and impact, with a title per quadrant and labels that never overlap.

point-click.title: Clicked task and quadrant
point-click.description: An Eisenhower matrix with the urgent tasks on the left (reversed x axis): click a task or the empty area of a quadrant.

triage.title: Badges, counts and selection
triage.description: badge and description in the quadrants, the show-counts attribute (or a showCounts function), selectedIndex set on minerva-point-click, and minerva-point-drop to move a task.

props.hideTicks: Hides the numeric ticks of the axes (only the matrix remains)
props.hideLabels: Hides the labels next to the dots
props.dragPoints: Lets the user drag the dots (minerva-point-drag while moving, minerva-point-drop on release; update points to move them); also enables the Shift + arrow moves of the keyboard
props.noAccessiblePoints: Leaves out the visually hidden list of the dots (arrows between the dots, Enter to click, Shift + arrows to move the focused dot, focus ring)
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.activeIndex: Index of the point whose card shows the point-actions slot: the hovered point, else the keyboard-focused one, else selectedIndex (null: none, or during a drag); read only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-point-click: A dot was clicked; detail: { point, index }
events.minerva-point-double-click: The same dot was clicked twice in quick succession; detail: { point, index }
events.minerva-quadrant-click: The empty area of a quadrant was clicked; detail: { quadrant, x, y }
events.minerva-point-drag: A dot is being dragged (on every move, before the drop); detail: { point, index, x, y, quadrant }
events.minerva-point-drop: A dragged dot was released, or the focused dot was moved with Shift + an arrow key; detail: { point, index, x, y, quadrant }
events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

slots.quadrant-header-top-left: Header of the top-left quadrant, in its outer corner (replaces its drawn title, badge, description and count)
slots.point-actions: Actions shown in the point card of the active point, beside its name (e.g. compact edit / delete buttons); with actions, the selected point keeps its card; it receives pointer events

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
